abstract: The DCC tumor suppressor gene has been shown to be frequently deleted or its expression reduced or absent in colorectal, gastro-intestinal, pancreatic, prostatic, and breast carcinomas, and glioblastomas. By allelotype analysis using the DCC-flanking polymorphic marker D18S5 we have previously shown that allelic deletions at 18q21 occur in 40% of male germ cell tumors (Murty et al., 1994). In order to further understand the role of DCC gene in germ cell tumorigenesis, we evaluated deletions by loss of heterozygosity (LOH) and mRNA expression by RT-PCR in tumor tissues and cell lines. Analysis of 61 paired normal-tumor DNAs using the probes D18S5, JOSH 4.4 (a polymorphism within the DCC locus) and a (CA)n polymorphism in an intron of DCC revealed that 45% of GCTs had allelic deletions. In addition, two homozygous deletions were found in the DCC gene among 91 (61 used in the LOH analysis and an additional 30) tumor DNAs when screened with the cDNA probes (pDCC 1.65, pDCC 1.9 and pDCC 1.0). By RT-PCR analysis of four normal testes, nine GCT cell lines and 14 tumor tissues, DCC gene expression was detected in all four normal testes, while four (45%) GCT cell lines and one (7%) tumor specimen showed lack of expression. In addition, DCC expression was highly reduced in three (21%) tumor tissues. The high frequency of LOH at 18q21 was characteristic of seminomas as well as all subsets of non-seminomas in primary as well as metastatic states. Frequent allelic loss in all histologic subsets, homozygous deletions, and loss of expression of DCC suggest that suppression of this gene's function is an early event in GCT development.
abstract_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍では、18q21に位置する腫瘍抑制遺伝子DCCの欠失が報告されている。本研究では、61組の対になる正常・腫瘍DNAについて、D18S5、JOSH 4.4およびDCC内のイントロン(CA)n多型を用いてLOH解析を行った。その結果、45%の胚細胞腫瘍に対立遺伝子欠失を認めた。さらに、cDNAプローブ（pDCC 1.65、pDCC 1.9、pDCC 1.0）を用いた解析により、計91例の腫瘍DNA（LOH解析の61例と追加の30例）のうち2例でDCC遺伝子のホモ接合欠失を認めた。正常精巣4例、胚細胞腫瘍細胞株9株および腫瘍組織14例についてRT-PCRを行ったところ、正常精巣4例ではすべてでDCC発現を認めた一方、細胞株の4株（45%）と腫瘍組織1例（7%）では発現が消失していた。さらに腫瘍組織3例（21%）では発現が著明に低下していた。18q21の高頻度のLOHは、原発性・転移性のいずれの病変においても、セミノーマおよびすべての非セミノーマ組織型で特徴的にみられた。全組織型での頻繁な対立遺伝子欠失、ホモ接合欠失、DCCの発現消失は、本遺伝子機能の抑制が胚細胞腫瘍発生の初期事象であることを示唆する。
